# VitalRPA: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-07 · code 191190e4c3da · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** Website robots for busy teams: uptime checks every hour, SSL and domain expiry watch, a visitor beacon under 1 KB, and playbooks that act when something breaks.
**Live:** https://vitalrpa.com · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/VitalRPA · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `.claude/skills/vitalrpa/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py vitalrpa` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **Native Forms since branch `forms` (2026-11-07).** The old JavaScript-template source (`VitalRPA/web/pages/*.html` +
  `tools/deploy.py`) is not used here; this folder is the Anvil app itself.
- **Charts stay JavaScript**: `theme/assets/vr-charts.js` (the old `window.VR`) draws the 24-hour strip, 90-day bars,
  sparklines, column bars, bar lists and the response-time line chart, plus the shared `[data-tip]` tooltip, copy and
  the beacon snippet (`VR.snippet`, must stay under 1 KB). Python reaches it through `client_code/vr.py` (formats in
  UTC "robot time" + `vr.draw`) and `Components/Chart` (kind / data / opts).
- **Site page = head + one tab Form**: `Pages/Site` keeps the head and tab links and puts a Form from `SiteTabs/`
  (Overview, Traffic, Checks, Errors, Install, Settings) into its LinearPanel; tabs call `page.set_site(s)` /
  `page.reload(tab)`. Tab links are real `#site/<id>/<tab>` addresses (the router re-opens the page).
- **Open-incident count** on the Incidents menu link: pages call `state.set_open(n)` after loading (mine only;
  0 for the sample fleet); `state.set_shell` lets Shell redraw its menus (`Shell.show_counts`).
- **Timers**: the UTC clock lives in Shell (show/hide); the console's 60 s refresh starts on show and stops in
  `leave()`, which `router.show()` calls on the page being left (and on hide).
- Most item Forms set display text through `anvil:dom-node` + `textContent` (lighter than Labels in long lists).
- Server code is the old code with type annotations only (`changes: dict = {}`, `fields: dict = ...`,
  `getattr(anvil.server, "session")`) so `anvil validate` passes; behaviour unchanged.
- `tools/ui/smoke.js` opens every address as guest / member / admin; flow.js, phone.js, admin.js, a11y.js and
  design.js are full journeys (all passed at conversion).
<!-- /NOTES -->

## Data tables (`anvil.yaml` db_schema)

- **actions_log**: owner→users, at:dt, playbook:str, subject:str, action:str, target:str, result:str, ok:bool, is_demo:bool · used in Alerts, Bots, DemoData
- **app_settings**: key:str, value:obj · used in common
- **bot_runs**: bot:str, at:dt, ms:num, handled:num, summary:str, ok:bool, is_demo:bool · used in Bots, DemoData
- **checks**: site→sites, at:dt, ok:bool, slow:bool, code:num, ms:num, error:str, source:str, is_demo:bool · used in Bots, DemoData, Monitor, Sites
- **daily**: site→sites, day:date, checks:num, fails:num, ms_sum:num, views:num, visitors:num, errors:num, load_sum:num, load_n:num, ttfb_sum:num, pages:obj, refs:obj, devices:obj, hours:obj, is_demo:bool · used in Bots, DemoData, Monitor, Sites, StatusPage
- **feedback**: user→users, name:str, email:str, kind:str, message:str, context:obj, status:str, note:str, created:dt · used in Feedback
- **heartbeats**: owner→users, name:str, token:str, period_min:num, grace_min:num, last_ping:dt, status:str, pings:num, created:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Beacon, Bots, common, DemoData
- **incidents**: owner→users, site→sites, heartbeat→heartbeats, kind:str, severity:str, title:str, detail:str, started:dt, resolved:dt, resolution:str, acked:bool, notes:obj, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, Bots, DemoData, Incidents, Sites, StatusPage
- **jserrors**: site→sites, message:str, source:str, path:str, count:num, first:dt, last:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Beacon, DemoData, Sites
- **playbooks**: owner→users, name:str, trigger:str, site→sites, actions:obj, enabled:bool, fired:num, last_fired:dt, created:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Alerts, Bots, DemoData, Sites
- **sites**: owner→users, name:str, url:str, site_key:str, interval_min:num, keyword:str, expect_status:num, slow_ms:num, quiet_hours:num, tags:obj, paused:bool, status:str, status_since:dt, last_check:dt, next_check:dt, last_ms:num, last_code:num, last_error:str, fails:num, slow_streak:num, ssl_expires:dt, ssl_issuer:str, ssl_error:str, domain_expires:dt, domain_error:str, inspected:dt, sec_headers:obj, page_bytes:num, server:str, last_beat:dt, created:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, Alerts, Beacon, Bots, common, DemoData, Sites, StatusPage
- **status_pages**: owner→users, slug:str, title:str, intro:str, site_ids:obj, public:bool, created:dt, is_demo:bool · used in DemoData, Sites, StatusPage
- **users**: email:str, enabled:bool, last_login:dt, password_hash:str, n_password_failures:num, confirmed_email:bool, signed_up:dt, display_name:str, is_admin:bool, is_demo:bool, last_seen:dt, legal_version:str, legal_accepted_at:dt, legal_source:str, alert_email:str, alerts_on:bool, digest_on:bool · used in Admin, Bots, common, DemoData
- **visits**: site→sites, day:date, visitor:str · used in Beacon, Bots, DemoData, Sites

## Biggest files (read these in parts)

`theme/assets/app.css` 1086, `anvil.yaml` 988, `server_code/DemoData.py` 437, `server_code/Sites.py` 409, `server_code/Bots.py` 369, `server_code/Alerts.py` 277, `server_code/seo_routes.py` 259, `server_code/Probe.py` 258

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
